cohort: A 40-year-old woman who developed symptoms seven years after undergoing an emergency caesarean hysterectomy for postpartum haemorrhage.
finding: A retained surgical gauze (gossypiboma) can remain undetected for seven years, presenting with diverse and recurring symptoms that can mimic other serious conditions, emphasizing diagnostic complexity and the critical role of prevention.
mod_finding: The gossypiboma was a consequence of an emergency caesarean hysterectomy, indicating a potential severe complication linked to caesarean delivery.
